newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE telecoms unit ups stake in online group.
newsitem.headline: RWE telecoms unit ups stake in online group.

text.p: The telecommunications subsidiary of the German diversified utility RWE AG, RWE Telliance AG, said on Friday it had increased its holding in the German online service germany.net GmbH to 65 from 25 percent.

"Since February RWE Telliance has continually expanded its shareholding and it now holds 65 percent of the Frankfurt company, which has been on a path to success since it was set up in 1995," RWE Telliance said in a statement.
Other shareholders in germany.net include the Deutsche Bank unit Gesellschaft fuer Finanzmarketing, with 25 percent, and the founding member Michaela Merz with 10 percent.
RWE Telliance said that germany.net has 140,000 participants.
